changes.title: Massachusetts Sen. Markey wins primary over opponent who called for generational change
changes.summary: Sen. Ed Markey, 80, defeated Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who had attempted to argue that it was time to do away with the "status quo" in his pursuit to oust the octogenarian.

changes.title: Ed Markey defeats Seth Moulton in Massachusetts' Democratic primary for Senate
changes.summary: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey has won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts.

changes.title: Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary pits age against ideology
changes.summary: Younger centrist Seth Moulton and older progressive Ed Markey are fighting for the Senate nomination in the Massachusetts Democratic primary. CBS News congressional reporter Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: Moulton says he shares same progressive values as Markey but isn’t afraid to challenge establishment
changes.summary: Rep. Seth Moulton (D-Mass.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his primary challenge to incumbent Sen. Ed Markey (D-Mass.).

changes.title: Rep. Seth Moulton targets Sen. Ed Markey in Massachusetts Democratic primary amid broader calls for generational change
changes.summary: The primary is crucial in heavily Democratic Massachusetts, and the winner will be expected to prevail in November's general election.

changes.title: In Massachusetts, Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton vie for Senate nomination
changes.summary: Sen. Ed Markey faces Congressman Seth Moulton in the Massachusetts Senate primary. Both candidates have similar progressive platforms.
